purpose: training-only automatic binding to observed CPU writer and bounded computation
inputs: live confirmed native-event CPU/GPU correspondence, not oracle data
identity: immutable event-prefix SHA256 within the owned live process
observed writer PC and runtime code bytes

slice_observer.mechanism: hardware execution breakpoint and bounded trap-flag steps on previously observed writer threads
slice_observer.memory_per_instruction: at most two operands, at most 32 bytes each

admission_to_observation: unoccupied debug registers; no attached debugger; private committed watched memory; no change to application data or instructions

replay.rounding: float32 nearest; non-default rounding/FTZ/DAZ and non-normal arithmetic inputs rejected
replay.control: only the actually observed bounded path; no claim about unobserved branches
replay.holdout: third call is verified separately, not used to change the instruction model
replay.not_verified: full architectural equivalence, upper vector state, arbitrary-input MXCSR exception effects, ownership

GPU_witness: up to three additional completed snapshots requested by inferred resource id/generation; common QPC proves observed CPU store precedes matching subsequent GPU copy recording
stop: remove owned breakpoints, clear owned TF, preserve last-error/NT-status; keep inactive handler/DLL until process exit to avoid handler-unload races
configuration: run.py exposes watch-events/watch-ms/slice-calls/slice-ms and event-buffer-budget-kib; budgets below fixed x64 event reservation are rejected before launch
